cards.title: Plain TLS path (default)
items: Server authenticates to client via X.509 cert (SAN must include example.com)
Client never presents a certificate — anonymous to the server at TLS layer
identity / authorization moves to the application layer (cookie / JWT / header)

cards.title: mTLS branch (only if server requests client cert)
items: After ServerHelloDone: server sends CertificateRequest
Client replies with Certificate chain + CertificateVerify (ECDHE sig over handshake hash)
Server validates client cert against its TrustConfig (CA bundle)
If validation fails → bad_certificate / certificate_required alert + TCP close
Business case: GLB mTLS at safe/ssl/../public-mtls-global-ingress/ ADR-014

cards.title: OSI layer mapping
items: Stage ① URL parse → L7 Application (local)
Stage ② DNS → L7 protocol over L4 UDP/53
Stage ③ TCP → L4 Transport (3-way handshake)
Stage ④ TLS → L5 Session + L6 Presentation (SNI in ClientHello, cert in ServerHello)
Stages ⑤⑦ HTTP → L7 Application (encrypted inside TLS)
Stage ⑧ TCP close → L4 (FIN/ACK + TIME_WAIT)

cards.title: Latency budget (typical)
items: DNS cache hit: <5ms; cold cross-continental: 20-100ms
TCP handshake: 1 RTT (~10-50ms cross-region)
TLS 1.3 handshake: 1 RTT (~10-50ms)
Server processing: 50-500ms (LB + handler + DB)
Total cold path: ~250ms end-to-end (cross-region)
Hot path (cache + keep-alive): <50ms after first request
